content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for ICAR IIGR Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 27-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the ICAR IIGR Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the ICAR IIGR Recruitment 2026 is 27th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in the ICAR IIGR Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 9 vacancies are available for the posts of Young Professional-I, Young Professional-II, Lab Assistant, and Field Assistant in the ICAR IIGR Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for the ICAR IIGR Recruitment 2026 is through email. Candidates need to send their applications to the official email address provided.

faq.question: Q4. What is the minimum and maximum age limit for the posts?
faq.answer: The minimum age limit for all posts is 21 years, and the maximum age limit is 45 years. Age relaxation is applicable for SC/ST/OBC and Divyang candidates as per government rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Young Professional-I post?
faq.answer: The salary offered for the Young Professional-I post is Rs. 30,000/- per month on a consolidated basis.

faq.question: Q6. What are the educational qualifications required for the Lab Assistant post?
faq.answer: The educational qualification required for the Lab Assistant post is a Graduate degree in Agriculture/Microbiology/Life Sciences.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for ICAR IIGR Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the ICAR IIGR Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting of applications followed by an online interview. Candidates are advised to prepare accordingly.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the ICAR Indian Institute of Groundnut Research located?
faq.answer: The ICAR Indian Institute of Groundnut Research is located in Junagadh, Gujarat.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: The job type for all the advertised positions in the ICAR IIGR Recruitment 2026 is contractual.
